idea-plugin.name: ArcDrift
idea-plugin.description:
Polyglot contract guardrails, C4 canvas & MCP verification for JVM ↔ TypeScript/Python teams.

ArcDrift is a polyglot architecture control plane, source-inferred cross-language contract verifier, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for IntelliJ IDEA.

  • Cross-Language Contract & Boundary Guardrails: Catch broken REST/Kafka routes and DTO field drift (including @JsonProperty and @SerialName wire aliases) across Kotlin/Java, FastAPI, TypeScript, and Python before merge.
  • Interactive C4 & Class Architecture Canvas: Semantic zoom from Containers & Packages down to Spring Boot / Ktor Components and Classes.
  • Deterministic PSI Refactoring: Extract interfaces, move classes, rename symbols, and wire dependencies with single-step Undo/Redo.
  • MCP Verification for Coding Agents: Give Claude Code, Cursor, and JetBrains Junie architecture slices and pre-handoff compliance checks.
idea-plugin.change-notes: • 0.1.0: Initial release — Polyglot AST/PSI scanner, cross-language REST/Kafka contract verification, interactive C4 JCEF canvas, deterministic PSI refactorings, and OpenAI-compatible Self-Healing Agent workspace.
